messages:
Elaine: I want to propose a small deploy-bot subcommand to streamline release notes + pin reminders for quick rollouts. Sketch below.

Elaine: idea: `deploy-bot quickpin --version v1.2.3 --canary 10 --draft-notes` will produce a short release digest, a suggested pinfile, and a one-click rollback snippet.

Elaine: sketch of CLI usage:
```
# dry-run, prints digest + pin suggestion
deploy-bot quickpin --version v1.2.3 --canary 10 --dry-run --changelog CHANGES.md
```

Sam: nice. How does it determine what to pin? service image? model version? route config?

Elaine: quick heuristic: check manifests changed in diff against current release, prefer explicit pinning for runtime artifacts (model, image) and leave infra flags as suggestions. It will also run `deployctl diff-pin` to surface current pins.

Marta: please don't have it auto-apply pins. output should be a suggested `pins.yaml` and an optional `--apply` that REQUIRES `--confirm`.

Ken: also include a small cost/latency estimate for the canary step (we can query perf dashboard for baseline). Even a rough token/cost delta is useful.

Deploy-Bot: preflight check: no in-progress deploys on project/redwood-api. quickpin dry-run allowed. :white_check_mark:

Jen: Can it template release notes from CHANGES.md / PR titles? Ideally include links to PRs and a small 'why this matters' blurb.

Elaine: MVP plan: parse CHANGES.md and top N PR titles, summarize into 3 bullet points, output a release digest and a `pins.yaml` suggestion plus a rollback.sh snippet.

Elaine: example output (dry-run):
```
Release digest for v1.2.3 (canary 10%)
- Fix: KV cache illegal read causing 5xx under burst load (PR #412)
- Perf: batching improvements reduce p99 for short sequences by ~15% (PR #387)
- Ops: added graceful fallback for model variants (PR #399)

Suggested pins (pins.yaml):
- service: redwood-api:sha256:abcd1234
- model: redwood-reason-v3:q2

Rollback snippet (rollback.sh):
#!/bin/bash
# revert to previous pins
deployctl apply --pin-file pins.prev.yaml --rollout 100
```

Sam: can we also include an auto-generated top-level release note (one paragraph) so eng gets something to paste into release email?

Elaine: yes — generate a 1-2 sentence summary using the PR summaries. We'll include a `--draft-notes-file` flag so the output is a single file teams can edit.

Marta: add `--skip-pin-check` for emergency manual runs but default to safe guards. And emit a small checklist for on-call: canary health, error budget, escalation contact.

Ken: I'll add a small hook to collect a perf snapshot (qps, p99) and append it to the digest so SRE can compare pre/post.

Sam: I'll prototype a tiny python script to convert CHANGELOG -> bullet list and call the summarizer. I'll PR the sketch by EOD and link it here.

Elaine: great. Next steps: Sam + Ken + Marta to PR CLI flags and output format. I'll wire the bot endpoint and template the rollback snippet. We'll demo in next release prep meeting. :shipit:

Jen: ping me when there's a draft; I can help with phrasing and ensuring release notes meet compliance checklist.

Sam: ack, will post draft in a few hours.
